verdict.rationale: Rive documents a built-in AI agent and MCP tooling, but they generate scripts, layouts, data models, state machines, shapes and animation. These are structural and animation tasks, not the asset chores the story names. Nothing in the pack shows image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, or copy suggestions inside the editor, so the AI features are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor
